page.layout: One bookplate block in a double-ruled frame: title lines at upper left, oval portrait medallion at upper right, engraving of two houses at lower left, "SHELF No." line at lower right.
page.notes: Oval engraved portrait of a man in eighteenth-century dress, upper right, with no printed text. Engraving of two houses with a tree and fence, lower left, with no printed text. A purple library stamp reading "ADAMS" and a handwritten "264.7" sit beside "SHELF No." and are left out as library marks and shelf mark. Scan shows the plate pasted onto dark marbled board.
